fields.name: Helius Heater Hood
fields.short_description: The Helius Heater Hood can be installed in a recessed area in the sauna room to keep it hidden and away from bathers. Using the heater's separate soapstone water basin, water can be poured into the stones to generate steam. This design feature helps prevent accidental burns. The Helius Hood reduces the safety distance to the minimum.
